theme_and_concept.theme: Dark Mode Default - Electric & Neon (Archetype 7) adapted for Legal Tech
theme_and_concept.description: An unprecedented, tech-forward AI contract analyzer. Bilingual (Arabic/English) with RTL support. The UI should feel like a premium command center—deep obsidian backgrounds with electric cyan accents for technology and high-contrast neon red/orange for risk flagging.

rules: Use 'Readex Pro' for all headings (H1-H4). It has a modern, tech-forward geometric look that supports both English and Arabic perfectly.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' for all body text, UI labels, and data points. It provides excellent legibility for dense legal text in both languages.
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard defaults.

colors.instructions: Use deep obsidian (#0A0A0B) as the main canvas. Never use pure black or flat gray. Accent with Electric Cyan (#00E5FF) for primary actions and glowing effects. Use Neon Red (#FF3366) and Warning Orange (#FF9900) specifically for highlighting hidden contract clauses and penalties. Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers and floating toolbars, use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0B]/70 border-b border-white/10`. Add `backdrop-saturate-150`.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: For dashboard cards, use solid backgrounds (`#121214`) with a sharp 1px border (`border-white/10`). Add a subtle neon glow on hover for interactive cards (`hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.15)]`).
visual_enhancers.motion: Use smooth transitions for hover states (`transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out`). Animate risk scores with a count-up effect. Entrance animations for contract clauses should stagger in.

landing_page.layout: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for features. Large asymmetrical sections. Generous spacing (`py-24` or `py-32`).
landing_page.hero: Dark, imposing hero section. Headline should be massive. Add a subtle glowing grid or particle effect in the background.
landing_page.pricing: Bento box style for Free, Single ($3), and Monthly ($20) tiers. Highlight the Monthly tier with 'The Tracing Beam' animated border.

dashboard.layout: High Density Grid (Mode B). Strict hierarchy. Sidebar for navigation (history, settings). Top strip for remaining credits and upload CTA.
dashboard.cards: Cardless or 1px border style. Very sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`).

analysis_workspace.layout: Split-pane view: Document preview on the left/right (based on RTL), AI Insights on the opposite side.
analysis_workspace.insights_panel: List of clauses categorized by severity (Destructive/Red for penalties/auto-renewal, Warning/Orange for hidden fees, Success/Green for safe).
analysis_workspace.upload_zone: Large drag-and-drop zone with camera scan button, glowing dashed border on hover.

rules: The app MUST support Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR). Use `dir='rtl'` on the HTML tag or main wrapper when Arabic is selected.
Use logical Tailwind properties like `ms-` (margin-inline-start), `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `border-s`, `border-e` instead of `ml-`, `mr-`, etc., so layouts automatically flip in RTL.
Provide a language toggle in the header.

hero_background.description: Abstract blue and white neon light streaks for the tech-forward hero section background. Use with a heavy opacity overlay (e.g., bg-black/80) so text is readable.

dashboard_accent.description: Dark control panel texture, can be used as a subtle background pattern for the pricing or auth sections.

icons: Use `lucide-react`. Provide sharp, tech-oriented icons like `Scan`, `FileText`, `AlertTriangle`, `ShieldAlert`, `CreditCard`.
required_libraries: framer-motion (for smooth transitions and the tracing beam effect)
html2pdf.js or jspdf (for PDF export functionality)
testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='upload-document-button'`).
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a deep dark theme by default, overwriting standard Tailwind config colors with the palette provided.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for any surfaces containing text.
Ensure RTL support is robust. Use Tailwind's logical properties (`ps-`, `me-`, etc.).
Mock the Stripe payment flow and AI analysis logic, but make the UI look functional and complete.
Build the split-pane analysis view carefully so the document and the AI warnings are visible side-by-side.
Do not center-align body text; left-align (or right-align in RTL) for legibility.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use the requested electric/neon dark theme.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles (sharp corners for this tech theme) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Add micro-animations for hover states and transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for marketing pages.
